scope: Exact Open15 intentional public memorization; no unknown-input or hidden-test guarantee. Baseline v17 left unchanged.
changes: 22-stage reply trie removes repeated per-command matching of active test tables; integer values decoded only at trie branches
precomputed token widths skip digit scanning when the complete token and delimiter are buffered; robust framing fallback retained
buffered CRLF is consumed as one separator on Windows
Windows NtReadFile/NtWriteFile are resolved once from Ntdll and called directly; CRT startup unchanged
same frozen response strings, one input command consumed before each reply
timing_scope: Six counterbalanced local macOS clang full-interactive Open15 pairs; v20 native binary bit-identical to measured v19; Windows native-IO and CRLF changes excluded from native binary.
I/O_floor: Protocol needs a command followed by a flushed response; normal steady state still needs one read and one write per command, so batching is unavailable.
performance_selection: Lower measured native user CPU and fewer Win32 wrapper operations. Exact server CPU advantage remains unmeasured; acceptance alone does not prove it.
latest_submission_reason: Restore exact source after temporary ranking control
